channel.title: Odunayo Bolarinwa: projects & updates
channel.description: New projects, case studies and site updates from Odunayo Bolarinwa, full-stack web developer and web designer in Lagos.

item.title: Site update v2.5
item.description: New project: this portfolio itself, with its own case study, number 3 in Works and on the home page. PrepMaster moves off the home page's Featured Works (it's still in Works). Sharper logo: redrawn as a vector so it stays crisp at any size. Light mode: no more dark shadows under the scrolling banners. Project images now load in the background once a page is ready, so they're there when you scroll to them. Music turned down further. Sitemap updated with the new project and last-updated dates, plus a new RSS feed (linked in the footer) so search engines and feed readers pick up new work straight away.

item.title: Site update v2.4
item.description: New full-screen menu: shutters drop over the page and the links stand up in 3D. On desktop the list tilts with your mouse and the word you point at lifts in green with a giant outline behind it. On phones it is a stack of big numbered slabs with the controls in a thumb dock, and you can swipe down to close it. The logo now leads the home hero, right above the photo; the sound, x-ray, theme and language controls sit smaller at the top left. Clicks now make a short video-game keypad blip, and the music and clicks are quieter. Works page: shorter intro, and the project count now reads 22+ (it includes the custom Shopify and WordPress themes and plugins).

item.title: Site update v2.3
item.description: Sound: a mysterious ambient soundscape and a click sound, all generated live in the browser (no audio files). It starts as you enter and only plays while you are on the tab; the speaker button in the nav and mobile menu turns it off.

item.title: Site update v2.2
item.description: Home hero: a code-to-photo portrait. Move your mouse over it (or watch it sweep on phones) to decode the code back into the photo. Smart cursor on desktop: it says VIEW, OPEN, PLAY or DRAG depending on what you point at, with a soft spotlight in dark mode. The original home portrait now lives on the About page.

item.title: Site update v2.1
item.description: CULTUR FM Totes: new Featured build for the Tote Emails plugin (v2.0.0), with branded confirmation and dispatch emails and automatic Printful tracking. Email screenshots show customer details redacted.

item.title: Site update v2.0
item.description: Every project now has its own case study: the story behind it, how it was built and the results, with stat tiles for the real numbers. MailOptin case study with new desktop and mobile screens; BLASTFEST includes the video feedback.

item.title: Site update v1.9
item.description: Case studies: ADDOZ gets a full write-up (challenge, approach, what I built, stack and outcome) with stacked screen cards and mobile views. Every project with a live site now shows the tech it actually runs on. New live links for 1Seven4, GiftCardsNaira, Snap & Stem and MailOptin.

item.title: Site update v1.8
item.description: New FAQ page with straight answers about how I work, and a changelog (you're reading it). Services and copy now lead with custom full-stack development. Personal Archive photo sliders can be dragged with the mouse. Faster loading: top images load first, heavy effects wait their turn. Smaller cookie notice on desktop. CFM Waitlist plugin updated to v2.3.2.

item.title: Site update v1.7
item.description: "From Lagos to the world": an interactive map of where my clients are, with flight lines and per-country project lists. CFM Waitlist plugin updated to v2.2.8.

item.title: Site update v1.6
item.description: Start a project: a shareable 3-minute project brief at /start/, with personal links and saved drafts. Contact page shows a live "will he reply soon?" status from the Lagos clock.

item.title: Site update v1.5
item.description: Moved to the custom domain odunayobolarinwa.com. Landing banner gets a light/dark switch and a welcome smiley.

item.title: Site update v1.4
item.description: X-ray mode: press X (or tap the X button) to see the tech behind every section, with live load stats.

item.title: Site update v1.3
item.description: Featured builds for CULTUR FM Tickets, the Webhook Proxy and the CULTUR FM Totes custom shopping flow. Country flags on every project.

item.title: Site update v1.2
item.description: Featured builds for CFM Waitlist, PrepMaster, and Snap & Stem's Add a Tip and EN ⇄ FR language switcher.

item.title: Site update v1.1
item.description: "In Their Words": six client testimonials in a scroll-lit card stack. Personal Archive bento gallery; X (Twitter) added to socials.

item.title: Site update v1.0
item.description: Launch of the grunge editorial redesign: five languages, light/dark mode, GSAP motion, a Vue works filter and a Three.js hexagon.

item.title: Site update v0.1
item.description: First build of the new portfolio.

item.title: CULTUR FM Totes
item.description: E-commerce storefront for CULTUR FM's limited-edition Face Totes merchandise, part of the brand's wider digital platform. It runs on WordPress and WooCommerce, but the shopping experience is custom-coded: a branded add-to-bag overlay, a bag icon that only appears once something is in it, and bespoke cart, checkout and thank-you pages.

item.title: CULTUR FM
item.description: Official CULTUR FM digital platform: homepage, events, mixes and ticketing, powered by three plugins I built from scratch: CULTUR FM Tickets, a multi-event ticketing and gate-validation engine with QR-coded PDF tickets; CFM Waitlist, which runs each event's waitlist, ticket sales, free sign-up and sold-out states; and a Webhook Proxy that sends website form submissions straight into Google Sheets.

item.title: Odunayo Bolarinwa Portfolio
item.description: The site you're on. Designed and hand-coded from scratch with no template, theme or page builder: a custom Python build system, five languages, dark and light modes, a case study for every project and interactive details like a code-to-photo portrait, a 3D full-screen menu and generated ambient sound.

item.title: BLASTFEST
item.description: Official website for a Seattle Afrobeats music festival, with recurring annual redesigns and campaign pages built around each event cycle since 2023.

item.title: Addoz Integrated Resources Limited
item.description: ADDOZ is a recruitment platform for Addoz Integrated Resources, a Lagos HR outsourcing and recruitment consultancy. I rebuilt it from a limited WordPress site into a custom Next.js application with candidate, employer and admin workspaces, an approval-based job marketplace and secure CV handling.

item.title: Olaedo Cosmetics
item.description: Brand identity and visual direction project with supporting identity, packaging and presentation assets.

item.title: Daffodils Africa
item.description: Purpose-built website for an Africa-focused organisation with an integrated chatbot experience, maintained since 2023.

item.title: DailyGlowBar
item.description: Shopify store built from scratch with theme development and Liquid customisation.

item.title: Youzed Interiors
item.description: Brand identity, logo and website for Youzed Interiors, a US-based interior design business in Austin, Texas: from the visual identity through a handed-over, client-approved site.

item.title: Snap & Stem Creative Studio
item.description: Main website for Snap & Stem Creative Studio, where flowers meet artistry: a shop for bouquets and vase arrangements alongside the studio's story and mission, built to sit beside its photography site. Includes custom-built Shopify-style tipping at checkout and an IP-aware English / Canadian French language switcher.

item.title: 1seven4
item.description: Website for a UK-based DJ management and artist development company.

item.title: Borrow A Camera
item.description: Camera and equipment borrowing and rental platform, with e-commerce, real-time availability, custom booking logic and a streamlined checkout.

item.title: Discover234
item.description: Web development project for Discover234, a Nigerian history and culture site owned by The 234 Project Foundation, with an integrated AI chatbot (NaijaBOT), dynamic JSON-driven articles, daily quizzes and notifications.

item.title: DJx Branding

item.title: GiftCardsNaira
item.description: Website for GiftCardsNaira, a platform for trading gift cards and Bitcoin at top rates: a bold landing page, a clear three-step trading explainer, FAQs and a mobile-first layout.

item.title: MailOptin
item.description: Marketing website for MailOptin, a WordPress email automation plugin trusted by 5,000+ WordPress users: lead generation, automated emails and newsletters, pricing and integrations.

item.title: PrepMaster
item.description: PrepMaster is my own product for restaurants that sell through WooCommerce: it turns each day's orders into kitchen prep sheets automatically. Built from scratch as a PHP WordPress plugin with a Node.js/PostgreSQL backend, and sold with Free, Pro and Business plans through Freemius.

item.description: Webflow website project serving audiences in the USA and Nigeria.
